patch_description: Replace the placeholder implementation with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing optimizer for the 13-point Heilbronn problem. The objective is the normalized minimum triangle area (min triangle area over all C(13,3)=286 triangles, divided by convex hull area). Fast vectorized triangle-area computation via a precomputed combination index table, deterministic seeded RNG, geometric cooling schedule, and multi-start initialization (circle + jitter, random convex, uniform interior) to robustly find a configuration exceeding the benchmark score of 1.0. All logic is self-contained and returns a 13x2 numpy array.
